events.title: Liu Bang is crowned emperor, founding the Han dynasty
events.description: Liu Bang, a commoner who had risen in the revolts against the Qin and defeated his rival Xiang Yu, was crowned emperor. As Emperor Gaozu he founded the Han dynasty.
events.html: Liu Bang, a commoner who had risen in the revolts against the Qin and defeated his rival Xiang Yu, was crowned emperor. As Emperor Gaozu he founded the Han dynasty.

events.title: Hernán Cortés executes Cuauhtémoc, the last Aztec emperor
events.description: Held captive since the fall of Tenochtitlan, Cuauhtémoc was hanged during Cortés's expedition to Honduras on a charge of conspiracy. He is honoured in Mexico as a symbol of resistance.
events.html: Held captive since the fall of Tenochtitlan, Cuauhtémoc was hanged during Cortés's expedition to Honduras on a charge of conspiracy. He is honoured in Mexico as a symbol of resistance.

events.title: The National Covenant is first signed in Edinburgh
events.description: The National Covenant was first signed in Edinburgh's Greyfriars Kirk and then across Scotland, binding its signers to defend the Reformed religion against Charles I's innovations, especially his new prayer book and the power of bishops. It led to the Bishops' Wars.
events.html: The National Covenant was first signed in Edinburgh's Greyfriars Kirk and then across Scotland, binding its signers to defend the Reformed religion against Charles I's innovations, especially his new prayer book and the power of bishops. It led to the Bishops' Wars.

events.title: John Wesley gives Methodism legal standing
events.description: Wesley's Deed of Declaration made a conference of 100 preachers the legal governing body of the Methodist societies. It ensured the movement could survive him, though it formally left the Church of England only later.
events.html: Wesley's Deed of Declaration made a conference of 100 preachers the legal governing body of the Methodist societies. It ensured the movement could survive him, though it formally left the Church of England only later.

events.title: Congress votes to annex Texas
events.description: The House agreed to a Senate joint resolution offering annexation to the Republic of Texas, signed by President Tyler on 1 March. Mexico broke off relations, and war followed in 1846.
events.html: The House agreed to a Senate joint resolution offering annexation to the Republic of Texas, signed by President Tyler on 1 March. Mexico broke off relations, and war followed in 1846.

events.title: Watson and Crick work out the structure of DNA
events.description: At the Cavendish Laboratory in Cambridge, Francis Crick and James Watson arrived at the double-helix model of DNA, drawing on Rosalind Franklin's X-ray data. They published it in April.
events.html: At the Cavendish Laboratory in Cambridge, Francis Crick and James Watson arrived at the double-helix model of DNA, drawing on Rosalind Franklin's X-ray data. They published it in April.

events.title: Gulf War ceasefire takes effect
events.description: One hundred hours after the ground offensive began, coalition forces halted operations, Kuwait having been liberated. Saddam Hussein remained in power in Baghdad.
events.html: One hundred hours after the ground offensive began, coalition forces halted operations, Kuwait having been liberated. Saddam Hussein remained in power in Baghdad.

events.title: Federal raid on the Branch Davidians begins the Waco siege
events.description: A gun battle at the compound near Waco, Texas, killed four federal agents and six Branch Davidians. The 51-day siege ended on 19 April in a fire that killed 76 people, including children.
